title: docs(skills): the security rule states a grant's uniqueness by the declared `unique: 'organization'` index, in place of the retired `permission_set_id` column (#23615)
body:
Fixes #23615
Clause-②: no

## What

`skills/objectstack-data/rules/security.md` L49 read "`permission_set_id` is a legacy column: do not write it." The grant object `sys_user_permission_set` (`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/objects/sys-user-permission-set.object.ts`) no longer declares that column — a write naming it is refused `400 INVALID_FIELD` as an undeclared field (`grant-permission-set-name.test.ts`, the C7b NEGATIVE case) — so the sentence taught an AI author a key the declared shape does not have.

One line replaces it, in the paragraph that already teaches the by-name reference (`permission_set` takes the set's `name`) and its `400 VALIDATION_FAILED` refusals:

    One grant per user, set and organization: enforced by the `unique: 'organization'` index.

Each clause checked against the declared shape at `origin/main` `1ced0f82b`: the object's `indexes` carry `{ fields: ['user_id', 'permission_set', 'organization_id'], unique: 'organization' }` (L267; the module header L16–21 says the same), and the duplicate refusal — organization-scoped, platform-wide (organization NULL) and via update — is pinned in `grant-permission-set-name.test.ts` L282–347 (`409`, `UNIQUE_VIOLATION` on the wire). The retired column is not named: the reader is an AI author, and the refusal it would meet is already loud. `unique: 'organization'` and its NULL-safety are taught in this package at `rules/indexing.md` L53 and L71, so the sentence does not restate them.

Text only; no behaviour changes. One other file: `.changeset/23615-grant-unique-index-skill.md` (`@objectstack/skills` patch). The edited file ships: `packages/skills/package.json` `files[]` is `dist`, and `sync-catalog` copies `skills/**` into `dist/skills/**` byte for byte. Measured after `pnpm --filter @objectstack/skills build` (65 files copied, read back byte-identical): the new sentence is in `dist/skills/objectstack-data/rules/security.md` (1 hit) and `permission_set_id` is not (0 hits).

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么** — `skills/objectstack-data/rules/security.md` 权限集授予段落的最后一句。原句写「`permission_set_id` 是遗留列,不要写它」;现在改为「同一用户、同一权限集、同一组织只允许一条授予记录:由 `unique: 'organization'` 索引强制」。只改这一行,文件行数不变;另加一个 `@objectstack/skills` 的 patch changeset。

**为什么改** — 这份技能包随 `npx skills add` 发到客户项目,读者是写元数据的 AI。`permission_set_id` 列在 #23503 之后已从对象声明中删除(写它会被 `400 INVALID_FIELD` 拒绝),原句教给 AI 一个它看不到、也不能用的键;新句子陈述的是声明形状里真实存在、并有测试钉住的规则(每用户、每权限集、每组织一条授予,重复写入返回 409)。
